reviews.comment:
Esta a metros de la rotonda de entrada a Santa Clara del mar. Tiene una cafetería mínima con café para tomarlo ahí o llevarlo. Los empleados son muy amables, el problema es que cuando lo pedis para take away la tapa del vaso ajustaba mal y a pesar que lo tomamos con mucho cuidado cuando bebias el café con la tapa, indefectiblemente manchaba tu ropa sino que te quemabas. El café no lo venden barato, podrían comprar vasos térmico de mejor calidad, donde la tapa cierre bien

(Translated by Google)
It's just meters from the roundabout at the entrance to Santa Clara del Mar. It has a small café with coffee to eat in or take away. The employees are very friendly, but the problem is that when you order takeout, the cup lid doesn't fit properly. Even though we were very careful, when drinking the coffee with the lid on, it inevitably stained our clothes or even burned us. The coffee isn't cheap; they could buy better quality thermal cups with lids that seal properly.
